install.command:
set -eux
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y build-essential mold npm
sudo npm install --global n
sudo n "$(cat .node-version)"
hash -r
sudo npm install --global "$(node -p "require('./package.json').packageManager")"
git submodule update --init --recursive
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build:lix

prepare.command:
set -eux
git submodule update --init --recursive
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build:lix
